title: Finite affine sections generating on a compact open
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V an affine open, and K a compact open with K contained in V [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let H be a quasi-coherent O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent] whose restriction to K is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. There are n natural and an O_V-linear map from the free module sheaf on ULift(Fin n) to H restricted to V whose restriction to K is epimorphic. No submodule, monomorphism, or restricted isomorphism is asserted.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PF (label lemma-extend), final paragraph: finite principal cover, fractional generators, and their numerators; Lemma 01PB (label lemma-finite-type-module). Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PF

proof.text: Restrict H to Spec Gamma(X,V) using V.fromSpec. Its quasi-coherence makes the affine tilde counit an isomorphism. Use the presentation of the module of global sections by all its elements and relations and transport this presentation through the isomorphism. Transport back along the isomorphism with V.toScheme, then through the equivalence with the slice site Over V. This constructs a global GeneratingSections family sigma on H.over V without finite type on all of V. Lean implements this as the fully proved private helper exists_affine_generatingSections using presentationTilde, presentationRestrictOpensRange and presentationOverOfRestrict.

Apply the compact selection lemma to the specified generating family sigma and the finite-type restriction to K. It returns a finset S of sigma.I and the epimorphic restriction of freeMap(Subtype.val) followed by sigma.pi. This is the sole new unproved step; it no longer includes the affine global-generation construction.

Set n = Fintype.card S and use Equiv.ulift followed by (Fintype.equivFin S).symm to identify ULift(Fin n) with S. The freeFunctor sends this equivalence to an isomorphism of free sheaves. Compose its hom with the selected free map. Restriction sends the isomorphism to an isomorphism and hence an epi; composing it with the selected epi proves the desired Epi instance. Empty S gives n=0 without any additional case or hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 01PF, affine global-generation step, followed by Modules Lemma 01BB finite selection. Lean explicitly constructs the affine family and reindexes the selected finite subfamily; only compact selection is split off.

theorem exists_finiteType_affine_generators
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.affineOpens) (K : X.Opens)
    (hK : IsCompact (K : Set X)) (hKV : K ≤ V.1)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [H.IsQuasicoherent]
    [(H.over K).IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (φ : SheafOfModules.free
        (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V.1) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶ H.over V.1),
      Epi ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hKV)).map φ)
